notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla's flight-master wire: node-status query, taxi-map open (SMSG_SHOWTAXINODES with gate + nearest node + u32[8] known mask), the two flight verbs (single-hop ACTIVATETAXI when a direct TaxiPath edge exists, ACTIVATETAXIEXPRESS with the node chain when not), SMSG_ACTIVATETAXIREPLY codes, and SMSG_NEW_TAXI_PATH on first contact. MSUI implements the status query, map open, mask decode, single-hop activate and reply/lockout handling, but not the express verb or the first-visit learn packet.
